ala-baidu-1.webp.zh: 阿拉木图机场航站楼的白天外景：流线型屋顶下方的车道直通出发层。
ala-baidu-1.webp.en: Almaty's terminal by day — the flowing roofline with its ramp carrying traffic up to departures.

ala-baidu-2.webp.zh: 夜幕下的航站楼：红色霓虹灯「АЭРОПОРТ АЛМАТЫ」在玻璃幕墙上格外醒目。
ala-baidu-2.webp.en: At night the red neon 'АЭРОПОРТ АЛМАТЫ' glows above the glazed frontage.

ala-baidu-3.webp.zh: 冬季的航站楼前：积雪中停着出租车与旅客小巴，屋顶上的菱形装饰清晰可见。
ala-baidu-3.webp.en: A winter view in front of the terminal — taxis and minibuses in the snow beneath the roof's diamond finial.
